identity.title: List of Pokémon temporarily owned by Ash Ketchum

leadText: Several Pokémon have been temporarily owned by Ash Ketchum, the main protagonist in .
plainText:
Several Pokémon have been temporarily owned by Ash Ketchum, the main protagonist in .
 

==Released==
This section is for the Pokémon that Ash caught and released within the same episode.

 

 

 

 

 

==Temporary==
This section is for the Pokémon that Ash temporarily partnered with, many of which were rented and belong to another Trainer, or were wild Pokémon that Ash temporarily teamed up with.
